QUOTE: `PermissionManager::pattern_matches` splits the list entry at the first `:`: The part before the colon is an fnmatch glob on the tool name... Without a colon, the tool-name match is enough.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the fnmatch glob, the split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a colon-less pattern matches on the tool name alone.
